lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood greengrocer: a delivery-service notice, a first day helping cut radishes, a seasonal vegetable price list with a point-card bonus, a direct-from-farm corner notice, a new-staff shelf-stocking training comparison, a customer-preference listening training story, a trainee lesson on judging fresh vegetables, an explainer on why a discounted misshapen-vegetable corner started, a lunchbox vegetable set application guide, a bad-weather supply-chain column, a busy-day delivery reception rule, a column on the meaning of a greengrocer's trained eye, and a one-year direct-sourcing cooperation report with nearby farms. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
